document.about: Journal of Machine Learning Research 15 (2014), Srivastava et al., Dropout. On p19 its equations set a math-italic P before its bracket, P(h, v; θ), on lines that write no space characters.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#412): a line set tighter than its column read its word spaces from its own gaps (#388), and took the italic P's overhang before its bracket for one: P (h, v; θ). A bracket opening after a letter, a slash and a hyphen keep the column's threshold.

checks.issue: #412: P(h, v; θ) read P (h, v; θ).
